subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Wild animals: what a wild animal is, types, where they live and how they live; finding out about one wild animal

show.line: Wild animals live free in nature. Lions, elephants and zebras look after themselves.

rounds.prompt: Which one is a wild animal?
Wild or tame? Sort the animals.
Which wild animal has a long trunk?
Where can we safely see wild animals?

hints: Wild animals do not live with people.
Think where the animal finds its food and water.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I want a pet.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will keep a lion in my house!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A lion is wild. It is not a pet.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Lions are wild animals. They live in nature!

parent_line: Can tell wild animals from tame ones and say where they live.
